Dynamic import is used inside each test so every Red test reports its own contract-section comment in the failure output instead of the whole file failing at module-load time on a single missing export.

nonblocking_findings.description: POSIX filesystems forbid two filenames with the same basename in a single directory, so the 'duplicate by name' probe (test #5) cannot use a static fixture directory; it passes pre-loaded `agents` with two entries sharing the name `agent-a` via the `agents` option. The function contract MUST support this `agents`-as-override path (i.e., pre-loaded agents take precedence over `rosterDir`). If Jr Green chooses to load only from `rosterDir`, test #5 fails Green and the contract must be revised. This is documented in the test header.

The committed `expected-roster` source (e.g., config/expected-roster.json) per test-strategy.md Phase 1 'Architecture guardrails' is owned by Green; Red tests pass the expected roster inline (BASELINE_EXPECTED constant in tests/parity.test.mjs). Green may choose a different shape for the committed source, but the inline shape used here defines the minimum contract the function must accept.

npm test now reports 16-of-24 failing (vs the task description's 'at least 6-of-13'). The 13 → 24 jump is because tests/parity.test.mjs exposes 11 individual subtests via dynamic import (per-test failure reporting), not because of test bloat. The focused Red command `node --test tests/parity.test.mjs` reports 0-of-11 passing. This is stricter than the task's minimum Red falsification and satisfies 'at least one additional failure'.

handoff: Phase 1 Green must: (1) implement `rosterParity` in lib/core.mjs matching the JSDoc contract in tests/parity.test.mjs header (function accepts {agents?, rosterDir?, expectedRoster?} and returns {ok, agentCount, callableCount, agentCountLabel 'agent count: <N>', callableCountLabel 'callable count: <N>', findings[{class, name?, expected?, actual?, path?, detail?}]}); (2) make `agents` an override for `rosterDir` so test #5 (duplicate detection on pre-loaded agents) passes; (3) remove EXPECTED_AGENT_COUNT and EXPECTED_CALLABLE_COUNT from lib/core.mjs; (4) update tests/core.test.mjs to assert the derived contract not the frozen 24/22 snapshot; (5) verify node --test tests/parity.test.mjs exits 0 and npm test exit code reflects only the four S1 intentional-Red files (agents-snapshot, grammar, manifest, preflight). The committed expected-roster source (config/expected-roster.json or similar) is a Green decision — Red passes expectedRoster inline.
